question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**take**" means to occupy oneself with the act of having or experiencing something. (लेना)
 
• In the context of the sentence,** "take a moment to yourself" **is a common and appropriate expression.
 
• The other options: "**sleep**," "**carry**," and "**make**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *While you are at Chilika, take__ a moment to yourself and admire the beauty of this fabled lake.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sleep (सोना)**: means to be in a state of rest during which the eyes are closed and consciousness is completely or partially lost.
 
• **Carry (ले जाना)**: means to support and move someone or something from one place to another.
 
• **Make (बनाना)**: means to create, prepare, or put together.
